_comment: Golden ProviderResourceDescriptor for Google Drive (#523): a folder resource on a shared drive. Demonstrates a nested parent reference and screened namespaced extension metadata.
_expected_behavior: accepted — describes a discoverable Google Drive folder without governance, review, or binding authority
_authority_boundary: Provisional alpha provider-fact handoff object. It is NOT a SourceBinding, Source, SourceSnapshot, SourceEvidence, DecisionCandidate, review command, signoff, compliance, or event-store authority object. provider_metadata holds only screened, non-authoritative provider facts.
